user.title: Connect Mealie Discover
user.description: Enter the Mealie URL reachable from Home Assistant, an API token, and at least one search provider. Google search needs both an API key and a Programmable Search Engine ID.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials or query parameters
error.google_pair: Enter both Google search fields or leave both empty
error.provider_required: Configure at least one search provider
